description: This file defines a Java class CreateCodeCommandHandler that handles 'CREATE' commands for 'CODE' entities in the Fineract infrastructure, utilizing a service to perform the creation logic and integrating with the command-processing framework.

classes.name: CreateCodeCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring Service class that handles creation commands for code entities, implementing the NewCommandSourceHandler interface, and delegating the creation operation to CodeWritePlatformService.

methods.name: CreateCodeCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the CodeWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the JsonCommand to create a new code by invoking the createCode method of the write platform service within a transactional context.
